Omar Torres
omar.torres969@example.com | Indianapolis, IN
Omar Torres has 4 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Backend Engineer at Amber Systems (2025-2026), where they applied
distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 221K concurrent users.
Before that, Software Engineer I at Meridian Cloud (2022-2025). Education: B.S.
Information Systems, Purdue University, 2021. Core skills: Terraform, GraphQL,
PostgreSQL, REST API design, Distributed systems, Java, Microservices.
